chapter: Kid Rena, the Cadillac and Jones's sons
title: Rena's floor shows at the Cadillac
summary: Second reel: personnel of Rena's band and floor shows and dancing at the Cadillac.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Okay, it's going to second reel of John L. Jones, June the 5th, 1972. Okay? Mm-hmm. Let's see, you want me to ask you something? Yeah, you. I asked you about Kid Renee. Uh-huh. And you said you played with him at the Cadillac? At the Cadillac. Who was in the band then?
Brady Smith, Walter Daniel, uh, Silver Guster Handy, myself, and uh, that's about all.
But what kind of job was it?
We played a show down there.
What about dancing? Yeah, dancing too.
Rainey played it all by himself. But then, you see, he had a piano player, Walter Daniel. Mm-hmm. When he took down the piano, did the solo work.
I must have just missed you, because when I came to the Cadillac, they had a white band there. I didn't stay to listen.

Yeah, you had just gone. I think that was about 47 or something. Yeah, it was in Forest, yeah. Yeah. It was a man was down here for the Sugar Bowl game. But, was that a taxi dance hall that they had the girls on? No, no. No.
